questions.question: What do I do that makes it easier for you to finish an honest sentence?
What have you been editing out when you talk to me?
When we disagree, what helps you remember that the problem is not the person?
When do you feel my love without having to interpret it?
Which small gesture from me still lands every time?
What keeps taking the time we say we want for us?
What new experience would make us feel more awake together?
Plan a weekend that would restore us, not just photograph well.
Which dream of yours needs support rather than advice?
What have I done recently that made partnership feel real?
Which quality in me do you trust most when things are difficult?
Which moment from the last month do you want us to remember?
